# Frozen Lazy-family public interoperability inputs

The 886 source-only requests contain 125,863,316 source bytes and predict 811
admitted, 43 unsupported and 32 resource-limited outcomes under the frozen v4
policy. They preserve all 422 predecessor input/request pairs and add 340
ordinary Lazy/Lazy2 sources, four exact original selector prefixes, 64 explicit
boundary controls and 56 source-size/level boundary requests. Forty-three
complete Rust frame-equivalence hypotheses are fixed before codec execution.

`recipes.json` records source hashes, request fields, origin, classification and
all generator/input identities. Sources are deterministically reconstructed;
ordinary schedule/forced-branch observations remain separate. No applied C
scalar or identical Rust/C entropy-byte result is predicted. The four original
selector additions and all newly successful historical records need positive C
execution. The independent oracle is only a test executable, never the codec
implementation.

See `docs/reference-lazy-interop-protocol.md` for unchanged generic transport,
individual and aggregate bounds, planned full-unit sanitizer instrumentation
and independent audit requirements.

    python3 scripts/check_lazy_interop_recipes.py --check
